# Third-party artwork

Not generated by `scripts/build_site_assets.py` — everything else under
`assets/` is. Files here are somebody else's and are copied in verbatim.

## `app-store-badge.svg`

Apple's official **Download on the App Store** badge
(`Download_on_the_App_Store_Badge_US-UK_RGB_blk`), fetched from Apple's
Marketing Tools:

    https://toolbox.marketingtools.apple.com/api/v2/badges/download-on-the-app-store/black/en-us

Apple's Identity Guidelines govern it, and two rules bind what this site may do
with it:

- **Never alter it.** No recolouring, rotating, stretching, cropping, adding a
  border or a shadow, or setting it on a busy background. If the black badge
  ever stops working against the paper, the fix is Apple's white variant from
  the same endpoint — not an edit to this file.
- **Keep clear space of at least one tenth of the badge's height** on every
  side, and draw it no smaller than about 40px tall. `.badge` in
  `assets/site.css` does both.

The badge must link to the App Store product page and nowhere else. It is a
trademark of Apple Inc.; the footer says so.
